sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 127)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American and Latin American networks, Ted Fio Rito & Candy Candido on *The Fitch Bandwagon*, Harlow Wilcox delivering an urgent wartime salvage bulletin for the Office of War Information, country legend Eddy Arnold on *The Howard Miller Show* for Wrigley's Gum, Kalimán facing Mayan fire traps in *Los Misterios de Bonampak (Capítulo 45)*, and Johnny Olsen hosting NBC's *Second Chance* (1940–1967):
